bike_components_replaced_date_check.name: bike_components_replaced_date_check
bike_components_replaced_date_check.value: replaced_at is null or replaced_at >= installed_at

work_order_approvals_decision_check.name: work_order_approvals_decision_check
work_order_approvals_decision_check.value: (decided_at is null and decision is null) or (decided_at is not null and decision is not null and decision in ('aprobado', 'rechazado'))

work_orders_qc_check.name: work_orders_qc_check
work_orders_qc_check.value: status not in ('lista_para_retirar', 'entregada') or qc_approved_at is not null

work_orders_tax_doc_type_check.name: work_orders_tax_doc_type_check
work_orders_tax_doc_type_check.value: tax_doc_type is null or tax_doc_type in ('boleta', 'factura')

bikes_year_check.name: bikes_year_check
bikes_year_check.value: year is null or (year >= 1980 and year <= 2100)

customers_discovery_channel_check.name: customers_discovery_channel_check
customers_discovery_channel_check.value: discovery_channel is null or discovery_channel in ('instagram', 'google', 'recomendacion', 'sitio_web', 'paso_por_el_taller', 'otro')

blocked_periods_range_check.name: blocked_periods_range_check
blocked_periods_range_check.value: (start_time is null and end_time is null) or (start_time is not null and end_time is not null and start_time < end_time)

bookings_cancelled_by_check.name: bookings_cancelled_by_check
bookings_cancelled_by_check.value: cancelled_by is null or cancelled_by in ('customer', 'admin')

bookings_retiro_address_check.name: bookings_retiro_address_check
bookings_retiro_address_check.value: mode = 'taller' or (comuna in ('Vitacura', 'Las Condes') and address is not null)
